Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "aperture", "box": [ 0.13983866666666667, 0.22419999999999998, 0.2218666666666667, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "BOARD BELIEF", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "checkmark", "box": [ 0.5610386666666667, 0.22419999999999998, 0.1706666666666667, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "OPENAI ACCOUNT", "label_box": [ 0.492, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.4908, 0.0962, 0.01656, 0.5376 ], "color": "amber" } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** Split evidence panel. Left: `WHAT THE BOARD BELIEVED`, with the transcript-inspection diagram. Right: `WHAT OPENAI SAYS RAN`, with answer acceptance and no transcript-inspection arrow. A dusty amber gutter divides them.

**Action:** The narrative reveals that belief and deployment are not the same account.

**Caption:**
> METR SAYS THE BOARD EXPECTED TRANSCRIPT REVIEW. OPENAI SAYS ITS DEPLOYED SCORER DID NOT PERFORM THAT CHECK.

**Provenance:** `disputed` — attributed synthesis of `METR` and `OAI-OV`; the exact prompt, scorer configuration, and harness are not public.

", "title": "Belief and reported deployment differ" } }
